subject: Annual commitment: invoice tranche plan, escrow handoff, and VAT proofing
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@bluewave.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — schedule windows and tax evidence

Hi Priya / Karthik,

Thanks for the initial term sheet. Before we sign off I'd like to confirm two operational items so our treasury team can finalize wiring and our tax team can prepare VAT evidence: 

1) Invoice cadence: BlueWave prefers monthly invoices that align to calendar months and a single annual adjustment invoice at renewal rather than quarterly tranches. Is Redwood able to support month-by-month invoices against the committed amount (with committed spend reconciliation in December)?

2) Escrow / holdback: our procurement wants the first tranche to be placed into an escrow account and then released monthly as invoices are approved. Can you share escrow beneficiary instructions and a preview of the signature page we would sign?

If useful I can loop in our tax advisor (GlobalTax Solutions) — they need the Redwood invoice samples and the billing address used on the invoice to confirm VAT reclaimability.

Cheers,
Elena Gomez
CFO, BlueWave Analytics
Elena.gomez@bluewave.com

Attachments: (none in this message)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@bluewave.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual commitment — schedule windows and tax evidence

Elena — thanks for the clarity. See proposal below and attached invoice schedule (xlsx). High level: we can support month-by-month invoicing against the annual commitment with a single reconciliation invoice at year-end. We can also coordinate escrow wiring and provide the signature preview for the escrow authorization page.

Proposed operational plan (summary):
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly invoices issued on the 1st of each month for the prior calendar month usage. Invoices will reference the committed-spend agreement and include a line item showing remaining committed balance. Annual reconciliation invoice issued within 10 business days after contract anniversary to true-up usage vs committed spend.
- Escrow handling: Redwood can accept an upfront tranche to an escrow agent (we typically work with FirstTrust Escrow Ltd). We will provide an escrow beneficiary instruction packet and a signature-preview PDF. Escrow releases will be aligned to invoice approvals on receipt (monthly).
- VAT proofing: please attach the VAT registration certificate for BlueWave for the countries where you will reclaim VAT. We will include the billing address and tax ID on each issued invoice to support reclaimability.

Next steps / deadlines:
- By EOD Wed 11 Jul: BlueWave to provide VAT certs and preferred billing address (attachment: BlueWave-VAT-Registration-Cert.pdf)
- By Fri 13 Jul: Redwood to circulate finalized invoice schedule and escrow signature-preview (attachment: RWD-BlueWave-Commitment-Invoice-Schedule-2028.xlsx; Escrow-Instructions-Signature-Preview.pdf)
- Legal: Olivia/Olga to prepare the narrow escrow addendum for signature — cc'd.

I've attached the invoice schedule draft. Let me know if you want monthly invoice lines split 12 equal tranches or usage-driven monthly billing (we can issue estimated invoices and true-up).

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

Attachments:
- RWD-BlueWave-Commitment-Invoice-Schedule-2028.xlsx (proposed tranche layout)
- Escrow-Instructions-Signature-Preview.pdf (preview of signature page)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@bluewave.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Annual commitment — schedule windows and tax evidence

Thanks — a couple of finance/ops clarifications from our side to make sure the ledger and auditors are happy: 

1) Allocation method: If BlueWave opts to have estimated monthly invoices with a year-end true-up, Redwood will post revenue to the committed-spend ledger as the invoices are approved; the year-end true-up will generate either a credit memo or a balancing invoice. If BlueWave wants equal fixed monthly invoices (12 equal tranches), that's also fine and simplifies bookkeeping for both sides. Please confirm preference.

2) Escrow mechanics: Escrow agent requires an authorized signatory list and wiring instructions for both parties. We will provide a template in the escrow packet but need BlueWave's bank beneficiary details and an authorized signatory name and title.

3) VAT evidence: For EU VAT reclaim, we require a VAT registration cert and the legal billing address. For Canada/GST/HST we'll need provincial registration where applicable. If GlobalTax Solutions will act as your agent please include a signed letter of representation.

4) Tax holdback: if BlueWave requires a small refundable holdback (1-2%) to secure SLAs, we need to document release conditions (monthly invoice approval vs. performance milestones).

Can we lock the choices by Fri 13 Jul so our invoicing ops team can preload the invoice templates and accounting tags?

-Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: (none)

Hi Elena / team — thanks for the docs. We will proceed with the following and consider this our operational runbook: 

1) Invoice cadence and terms: Redwood will issue 12 fixed monthly invoices on the 1st of each month for the prior month, Net 30 terms. Each invoice will include: contract reference, committed balance, invoice number, billing address, BlueWave tax ID. Year-end reconciliation invoice will be issued within 10 business days of the anniversary.

2) Escrow: DocuSign envelope created and sent to procurement@bluewave.com; escrow packet attached for your treasury review. Escrow agent: FirstTrust Escrow Ltd. Please confirm authorized signatory listed as "BlueWave Analytics, Inc. — Treasury". Once executed, Redwood will provide the agent with release instructions tied to invoice approvals.

3) VAT and evidence: Accepted. Karthik, Marcus — please ingest the BlueWave VAT cert into the tax evidence folder and tag country-level reclaim flags. GlobalTax, if you can provide a letter of representation, please upload to the same Drive link.

4) Holdback: No holdback will be placed by Redwood by default. If BlueWave requires a 1-2% refundable holdback, we will document conditions; until we receive formal request, none will be applied.

Next actions and deadlines: 
- Fri 13 Jul EOD: Redwood to send DocuSign escrow addendum (done) and a sample invoice PDF (attached)
- Mon 16 Jul: AP teams to confirm wiring schedule after DocuSign completes
